1.explanation: The conversion from BoundaryEvent to IntermediateEvent on detach is implemented in DetachEventBehavior.js by intercepting the 'elements.move' command. However, the code bails out early when shapes.length !== 1, preventing batch moves from ever triggering the conversion logic. To fix this bug, DetachEventBehavior.js needs to be updated to handle multiple shapes (i.e. iterate over all selected boundary events) or otherwise remove the single-shape restriction so that batch moves also convert detached Boundary Events into Intermediate Events.
1.bug_scenario: In the screen recording the user has two BPMN Boundary Events attached to a task. They select both of them (a batch) and drag them off of their host onto the canvas. Instead of detaching and converting each boundary event into an Intermediate Catch/Throw Event, both shapes simply move as boundary events (still rendered as boundary events) rather than being detached and replaced.
